articles.summary: FL Studio is an institution. The digital audio workstation has been the backbone of music production for decades, and it remains the most downloaded music production software in the world. The product model is unusual for 2025: a one-time purchase starting at $99, with the most popular tier at $249. Buy once, own it forever.
